mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment_reservation_request r WHERE r.slot_id = #{slotId} AND r.reserved_at IS NOT NULL) AS charged, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_release_record x WHERE x.slot_id = #{slotId} AND x.status = 'SUCCEEDED') AS successful_release, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment_order o WHERE o.slot_id = #{slotId} AND o.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED','EXPIRED')) AS persisted_consumed, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment_reservation_request r WHERE r.slot_id = #{slotId} AND r.reserved_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM appointment_order o WHERE o.reservation_id = r.reservation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock_release_record x WHERE x.reservation_id = r.reservation_id AND x.status = 'SUCCEEDED')) AS pending_reserved, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment_order o WHERE o.slot_id = #{slotId} AND o.status IN ('CANCELLED','EXPIRED') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock_release_record x WHERE x.reservation_id = o.reservation_id AND x.status != 'SUCCEEDED')) AS pending_release, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_release_record x WHERE x.slot_id = #{slotId} AND x.status != 'SUCCEEDED') AS pending_compensations, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment_order o WHERE o.slot_id = #{slotId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM appointment_reservation_request r WHERE r.reservation_id = o.reservation_id AND r.reserved_at IS NOT NULL)) AS orphan_orders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment_order o WHERE o.slot_id = #{slotId} AND ( (o.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED','EXPIRED') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock_release_record x WHERE x.reservation_id = o.reservation_id AND x.status = 'SUCCEEDED')) OR (o.status IN ('CANCELLED','EXPIRED') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock_release_record x WHERE x.reservation_id = o.reservation_id)))) AS invalid_release, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment_order o WHERE o.slot_id = #{slotId} AND o.status IN ('PENDING_CONFIRM','CONFIRMED','CHECKED_IN','SERVING') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM active_booking_guard g WHERE g.appointment_id = o.id AND g.reservation_id = o.reservation_id AND g.user_id = o.user_id AND g.item_id = o.item_id AND g.service_date = o.service_date)) AS invalid_guard, ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment_reservation_request r WHERE r.slot_id = #{slotId} AND (r.created_at > #{stableBefore} OR r.updated_at > #{stableBefore})) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment_order o WHERE o.slot_id = #{slotId} AND (o.created_at > #{stableBefore} OR o.updated_at > #{stableBefore})) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_release_record x WHERE x.slot_id = #{slotId} AND (x.created_at > #{stableBefore} OR x.updated_at > #{stableBefore}))) AS recent_activity
